title: MSFS Marketplace Update: 15 NEW Airports & Stunning sceneries you don’t want to miss!
description:
This Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024 update for February 14, 2026, is a massive MSFS Marketplace Update for PC players! This week features a huge selection of MSFS new airports and MSFS new scenery, including the highly detailed EFRO Rovaniemi Airport, KDFW Dallas Fort Worth International by iniBuilds, and GVAC Cabo Verde Sal. If you are looking for the latest MSFS 2024 additions, we also have new MSFS DreamScenery lights for 2024 and essential flight simulator add-ons for your next flight.

In today's MSFS PC update, we explore everything from LFKJ Ajaccio and HKMO Mombasa Airport to the backcountry U60 Big Creek and the scenic GMMX Menara Airport.

✈️ New airports added this week (PC)
The following airports were newly released in the marketplace this week:
🛫 iniBuilds: KDFW Dallas Fort Worth International (Major US hub, high detail)
🛫 mkstudios: EFRO Rovaniemi Airport (Fly to Santa’s hometown in high fidelity)
🛫 FSDG: GVAC Cabo Verde Sal (Island holiday destination)
🛫 FSDG: HKMO Moi International Airport Mombasa (Kenyan hub)
🛫 Simulacion Extrema: 5138 El Chalten (Patagonian mountain airstrip)
🛫 NetDesign: CRL2 Rideau-Lakes Airport (Scenic Canadian GA stop)
🛫 SPINOZA: EDXE Rheine Eschendorf (Gliding airfield)
🛫 NMG Simulations: FAVG Virginia Airport (South African coastal airport)
🛫 IsmaBerk: GMMX Menara Airport (Marrakesh gateway)
🛫 FLY 2 HIGH: KHVN New Haven Airport (Northeast US regional field)
🛫 SPINOZA: KHWO North Perry Hollywood Airport (Busy Florida GA airport)
🛫 FSX3D: LFKJ Ajaccio Napoleon Bonaparte (Stunning Corsican resort)
🛫 Creative Mesh: U60 Big Creek (Backcountry gem for bush pilots)
🛫 Project MAX: WAMM Sam Ratulangi Intl Airport Manado (Indonesia’s northern gateway)

🌆 New sceneries added this week (PC)
The following sceneries were newly released in the marketplace this week:
🌆 DreamScenery: Oklahoma City, Topeka, Montreal, Helena, Santa Fe, Jefferson City, and Concord Enhanced Road Lights 2024 Edition
🌆 FSDG: FIMP Mauritius Airport & Island (Tropical island + airport enhancement combo)

If you're enjoying these updates, don't forget to like the video, subscribe, and drop a comment telling me which airport you're flying to first!

✈️ See you in the skies!
